summary_markdown: The discussion concerns the inclusion of virtual session data for a specific period. [me] clarified that while the required virtual sessions exist in `device_session_trusted` starting from 2025-07-01, they were not included in the model because they were missing from `v_device_session_agg_dev`. To resolve this, [me] proposed reinserting the segment of virtual sessions (2025-07-01 to 2025-09-24) using the latest version of the `insert_period` script. Following this, the model needs reprocessing to ensure the full period from 2025-07-01 is captured in `_ml2`. Finally, the necessary data must be reaggregated for the target period: 2025-07-01 to 2025-10-01. [p1] initially suggested copying the entire period (2025-07-01 - 2025-10-01), but agreed with the phased approach proposed by [me].
decisions: Reprocess virtual sessions for 2025-07-01 to 2025-09-24 using the latest `insert_period` script.
Reprocess the model to include the full period from 2025-07-01 in `_ml2`.
Reaggregate the required data for the period 2025-07-01 to 2025-10-01.
action_items: Implement the proposed script reinsertion and model reprocessing steps.
